findings.rootCause: Found while re-reviewing the cumulative diff: the b1 substitution-equivalence guard (P1 assured shared + widened P2 + P4 + P5) still admitted MINUS bodies in which a shared name occurs in a position that does NOT bind it in the body's own (standalone) evaluation. FilterIterator's substituted probe replaces the name everywhere, so: `MINUS { BIND(?x AS ?y) ?x :q ?y }` (BIND reads ?x before the body binds it), `MINUS { { FILTER(!BOUND(?x)) } ?x :q ?m }`, `MINUS { BIND(EXISTS{?x :r ?k} AS ?z) ?x :q ?m FILTER(!?z) }`, `MINUS { ?m :k ?v OPTIONAL { ?x :r ?m } ?x :t ?v }` (shared name bound only on the optional side) and `MINUS { ?m :k ?v MINUS { ?x :r ?m } ?x :t ?v }` (shared name local to a nested MINUS right side) all produced wrong results once the anti-join was selected (evaluation differential, ANTI_JOIN_FORCING_COSTS). P4 also only scanned FILTER/LEFT_JOIN scalars for sub-selects although its javadoc promised 'anywhere in R' (a sub-select in a BIND's EXISTS slipped through).
findings.change: PackedLogicalRuleProgram.minusBodyStructurallySubstitutable gains a substitutedScope mode: for the MINUS body and every relational sub-expression of it, referenced(S) ∩ shared must be assured by S (relationReferencedNames + relationAssuresAll). This is the classic 'certain variable' condition under which substitution equals selection; it subsumes the BIND/FILTER-before-binding, OPTIONAL-only and nested-MINUS-right-only cases and still admits the critique's nested MINUS whose left side assures the shared name (minusWithNestedMinusOnSharedVariableOnlyStaysRewritableAndCorrect stays green and still selects the anti-join). Inside nested EXISTS/IN/ANY/ALL bodies the check is off (the shared name is substituted from the enclosing row in both evaluations), so only P4/P5 apply there. P4/P5 now also scan EXTENSION/GROUP element scalars and ORDER keys. A pure decline guard: it can only remove alternatives. Also documented the hint invariant (planner half of 3.4.4) and the benign derived-EXISTS/user-NOT-EXISTS interning collision at the emission site, sorted the QueryEvaluationUtility import, and corrected the termIdentitySafe javadoc (Literal#equals ignores language-tag case; the value factories do not normalise tags).
